identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a social media automation tool that feels organic, human, and calm, contrasting the chaos of social media.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Swiss precision with Organic warmth.
Emotion First: The tool should feel 'calm' and 'focused'.
Content is King: Data and media take center stage; UI recedes.
Negative Space: Aggressive use of whitespace (p-8 to p-12).

headings.usage: Use weight 900 for major headlines (Landing), 300 for elegant subheads. Tight tracking (-0.02em).

body.usage: High legibility for dashboard data. Relaxed line-height (1.6).

primary.description: Deep Forest Green - Authority and Calm.

layout.spacing_scale: Generous. Use p-6, p-8, p-12. Avoid p-4.

grid_system.dashboard: Bento Grid (Mode B). Dense but with breathing room. Gap-6.
grid_system.landing: Tetris Grid (Mode A). Asymmetrical. Col-span-full for hero, col-span-4 for features.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 rounded-full px-8 py-6 text-lg font-bold shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300
buttons.secondary: bg-white border-2 border-primary/10 text-primary hover:border-primary hover:bg-primary/5 rounded-full px-8 py-6 font-medium transition-all

cards.style: bg-card border border-border/50 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300 rounded-2xl p-6

inputs.style: bg-white border-border focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/20 rounded-lg h-12 px-4 transition-all

navigation.style: glassmorphism. bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-border/50 sticky top-0 z-50

visual_enhancers.texture: Add a subtle noise texture overlay to the background (opacity 0.03) to kill digital flatness.

interactions.drag_drop: Scale up slightly (1.02) on drag start. Add shadow-xl.

hero.alt: Content creator working in a calm studio

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px. Color: CurrentColor (usually Primary or Muted-Foreground).
icons.platform_icons: Use react-icons/fa (FaInstagram, FaTwitter, FaFacebook, FaGoogleDrive) for brand logos.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. THEME SETUP: Update tailwind.config.js with the 'Organic Focus' color palette. Do NOT use default blue.
2. FONTS: Add the Google Fonts import to index.css immediately.
3. LAYOUT: Build the Dashboard using a 'Bento Grid'. Do not just stack cards vertically. Use col-span-2 for main charts.
4. LANDING PAGE: Use the 'Tetris Grid' for the features section. Use the 'Jupiter 2 Studio' image as the Hero background or side visual.
5. COMPONENTS: Customize Shadcn components. Remove the default 'radius-md' look and make it 'rounded-xl' or 'rounded-2xl'. Increase padding inside cards.
6. MOTION: Wrap the main dashboard grid in a Framer Motion <motion.div> with staggered children animations.
7. TEXTURE: Add a fixed position div with a noise background image (base64 or url) at z-index -1 to give the app texture.
8. CRITICAL: Do not use 'Inter' font. Use 'Manrope' for UI and 'Chivo' for Headings.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop': No generic gradients, no centered text blocks without purpose.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc.
